## v7.8.58 — 2026-10-26 · WP Rocket / Accelerator coexistence + signed self-updates
- **Change:** (A) a new LAST APO step (`_apo_coexist_marks`, -100000, inside the page-cache store) marks APO's OWN output for the two
  plugins most client sites run, which process the page after APO: WP Rocket's Delay JS gets APO's scripts in
  `rocket_delay_js_exclusions` (`data-apo-nodelay`, `\sid=.apo-`; a PHP filter); Accelerator active -> `seraph-accel-crit="1"` on
  every APO script; a lazy-loading plugin active -> `data-no-lazy="1"` on an image that already has `fetchpriority="high"` (WP Rocket's
  lazy load does not skip fetchpriority). (B) Accelerator active -> APO's `srcset` helper steps aside (it builds its own). (C) self-
  hosted updates: `Update URI` github.com + `update_plugins_github.com` read `stable.json` / `beta.json` from the public repo
  `gswagatrmt/apo-releases` (12 h cache, admin/cron only); the zip must sit under its `zips/` and carry an Ed25519 signature from the
  owner's offline key or WordPress is refused the download; channel on the Diagnostics tab; tool `_tools/publish_release.py`.
- **Presets:** A and B in all 7 (no-layout-risk: attributes only, nothing styles them). C is admin code, not a preset lever.
- **Worst case:** A - WP Rocket / Accelerator stop delaying APO's own small scripts and lazy-loading a high-priority image, i.e. APO's
  behaviour on every other site; C - a bad release reaches sites that click Update: an installed update goes live on the next admin
  page load (the v6.89.1 auto-refresh, same as a manual zip), so staging takes it first on `beta`; a tampered zip is refused by the
  signature check. Sites without those plugins: byte-identical output.
- **Kill switch:** `APO_NO_COEXIST_MARKS`, `APO_NO_COEXIST_SRCSET`, `APO_NO_SELF_UPDATE`.
- **Measured:** `test_v7858` 68 checks: no plugin = byte-identical (both live pages, Turbo+ and Turbo++; all 7 presets = v7.8.57
  apart from the block); WP Rocket's OWN matcher (its regex and escaping, read from its 3.22 source) excludes 39/39 and 44/44 APO
  scripts on the served pages and 0 of the sites' 77/83; updater: 7 refusal cases, 4 signature refusals, the download hook refuses
  a bad or missing signature. Not proven here: the real WP Rocket / Accelerator runtime (needs a test site with them installed).
